sections.title: Texas Financial Services Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key compliance considerations for Dallas FinTech AI development.

blocks.heading: Texas Department of Banking
paragraphs: State-chartered Texas banks and trust companies face TDB oversight alongside federal regulators (OCC, Federal Reserve). ClickMasters designs Dallas banking AI with TDB awareness alongside federal SR 11-7 requirements.

blocks.heading: Texas Department of Insurance (TDI)
paragraphs: Texas insurance AI — particularly auto and homeowner pricing — requires TDI rate filing compliance. ClickMasters designs Texas insurance AI with TDI rate filing and AI fairness guidance in mind.

blocks.heading: Texas Fair Housing Act
paragraphs: For real estate lending AI, Texas's state fair lending requirements complement federal ECOA and FHA requirements.

blocks.heading: No state income tax
paragraphs: Texas's zero income tax creates a competitive cost environment that has attracted Goldman, JPMorgan, and others to build large Texas operations — and makes DFW an attractive location for financial services AI investment.
